title: Spending tracker
notes: Sample CSV is fictional. All amounts are USD; negative amounts are debits and positive amounts are credits.
Income is an explicit category. Refunds reduce spending in their original category. Transfer rows are excluded from income and spending.
This is a cash-flow summary, not tax or investment advice. Categories are supplied by the user, not inferred.

sources.title: CFPB — Your Money, Your Goals toolkit
sources.use: Real-world basis for tracking and categorizing spending; sample transactions and software are original.
